summary.text: Mike Schultz is a Republican member of the Utah House of Representatives who has represented District 12 since 2015 and has served as speaker of the House since November 2023. He is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election against Democrat Anna Graff.

paragraphs.text: Mike Schultz was born and raised in Weber County, Utah, according to Ballotpedia.

At 20 he received his general contractor's license and started a home-building company, which he ran until 2023, and he has also managed other small businesses and owned and operated a family ranch in Croydon, Utah.
Schultz was elected to represent District 12 in 2014, defeating Democrat Joseph Marrero, and took office on January 1, 2015.
He became House majority leader in 2021 and was elected speaker by the chamber on November 15, 2023.

According to his official website, as cited by Ballotpedia, he has championed policies on increasing funding for Utah students, conserving Utah's water supply and investing in transportation infrastructure.
